key_expressions: It looks like it might rain,

A: Doesn't the weather feel a bit strange today?
And I think the wind suddenly got stronger.
What if it rains when I go home?
B: Yeah, it feels like there’s some fine dust too.
Right, it even feels colder because of the wind.
Just take an umbrella with you. It might shower later.

A: Why is it so hot today?
I seriously can’t stand it without air-conditioning.
Do you think it’ll stay hot in the afternoon too?
B: I know, right? It feels like midsummer.
Yeah, the sunlight is really strong today.
The forecast says it’ll stay hot until the evening.

A: Did you hear it might rain today?
I think I can already hear some raindrops.
Then I should definitely take an umbrella.
B: Yeah, they said there might be showers this afternoon.
Oh, you're right. The humidity suddenly went up.
Yep, you’ll regret it if you don’t take one.

A: The wind is pretty strong today.
My hair keeps blowing everywhere.
At this rate, my umbrella might even flip inside out.
B: Yeah, it even makes the temperature feel colder.
My hat almost flew away earlier.
It’s better to use a hood instead of an umbrella today.

A: The temperature difference between morning and evening is huge lately.
It’s cold in the morning but too hot in the afternoon.
I really don’t know what to wear.
B: I know, the weather is tricky these days.
I always bring both light and warm clothes.
Layering is probably the safest choice.

A: The sky suddenly got dark.
And the wind got stronger too—it really looks like rain.
I feel like it’s going to pour any minute.
B: Yeah, the clouds rolled in so quickly.
With this humidity, it’s almost certain.
We should probably move before it starts.

A: The air doesn’t feel very clean today.
My eyes even feel a bit irritated.
I should definitely wear a mask.
B: Yeah, the fine dust level is pretty high.
My throat felt scratchy too.
Wearing a mask really helps on days like this.

A: The sunlight feels really nice today.
It’s warm, so it actually lifts my mood.
A walk would be perfect in weather like this.
B: Yeah, it feels almost like spring.
The sunlight is soft and pleasant.
Let’s go out for a bit during lunch!

A: It’s a bit cloudy today.
I can’t focus well in weather like this.
I hope the sun comes out again soon.
B: Yeah, it’s one of those sleepy days.
I’ve been struggling to work too.
They say it’ll clear up soon, so hang in there!

A: Why is the weather so unpredictable today?
It was sunny earlier, but now it’s cloudy again.
It’s so hard to plan anything like this.
B: Yeah, the weather keeps changing lately.
Even the forecast isn’t very reliable.
As long as we’re prepared, we should be fine!
